name: Spectral Tracking with History-Aware Probabilities
aliases: Average-based Spectral Probabilities with Path History
definition: A spectral tracking method that uses history-aware average-based or maximum-based probabilities to bound path throughput, reducing estimation noise and preventing fireflies in chromatic media.
summary: Spectral Tracking with History-Aware Probabilities renders spectrally varying media by maintaining a single throughput vector and using path history to bound throughput, preventing fireflies and reducing noise compared to naive delta tracking.
